**Input:**

```json
{
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n// Park the dev client out of the way without pausing it.\n//\n// A minimized window is not \"hidden\", it is \"no render surface\": the client loop stops, and with it\n// the integrated server the agent lives in. Moving the same window off-screen keeps its surface alive\n// and keeps ticking, and SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE means it never takes the keyboard away from you.\n//\n// Usage: node scripts/window.mjs [offscreen|restore|state]\nimport { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';\n\nconst mode = process.argv[2] || 'state';\n\nconst powershell = (body) => execFileSync('powershell', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', body], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();\n\nconst findWindow = () => {\n  const line = powershell(`(jps -l | Select-String devlaunchinjector | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split ' ')[0] })`);\n  if (!line) throw new Error('no dev client running (jps found no devlaunchinjector)');\n  const hwnd = powershell(`[long](Get-Process -Id ${line}).MainWindowHandle`);\n  if (hwnd === '0') throw new Error(`pid ${line} has no top-level window yet`);\n  return { pid: line, hwnd };\n};\n\nconst PS = `\nAdd-Type -Namespace W -Name U -MemberDefinition @'\n[DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool ShowWindow(IntPtr h, int c);\n[DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool SetWindowPos(IntPtr h, IntPtr after, int x, int y, int cx, int cy, uint flags);\n[DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool GetWindowRect(IntPtr h, out R r);\n[DllImport(\"user32.dll\")] public static extern bool IsIconic(IntPtr h);\npublic struct R { public int Left, Top, Right, Bottom; }\n'@\n`;\n\nconst run = (body) => powershell(PS + body);\n\nif (mode === 'state') {\n  const { pid, hwnd } = findWindow();\n  console.log(`pid ${pid} ` + run(`$r=New-Object W.U+R; [W.U]::GetWindowRect([IntPtr]${hwnd},[ref]$r)|Out-Null; \"iconic=$([W.U]::IsIconic([IntPtr]${hwnd})) rect=$($r.Left),$($r.Top) $($r.Right-$r.Left)x$($r.Bottom-$r.Top)\"`));\n} else if (mode === 'offscreen') {\n  const { pid, hwnd } = findWindow();\n  // SWP_NOACTIVATE|SWP_NOZORDER keeps focus and stacking exactly where they are.\n  run(`[W.U]::ShowWindow([IntPtr]${hwnd},4)|Out-Null; [W.U]::SetWindowPos([IntPtr]${hwnd},[IntPtr]0,-32000,-32000,0,0,0x13)|Out-Null`);\n  console.log(`pid ${pid} parked off-screen; the integrated server keeps ticking and you keep your focus`);\n} else if (mode === 'restore') {\n  const { pid, hwnd } = findWindow();\n  run(`[W.U]::ShowWindow([IntPtr]${hwnd},9)|Out-Null; [W.U]::SetWindowPos([IntPtr]${hwnd},[IntPtr]0,80,80,1280,760,0x13)|Out-Null`);\n  console.log(`pid ${pid} back on screen at 80,80 1280x760`);\n} else {\n  console.log('usage: node scripts/window.mjs [offscreen|restore|state]');\n}\n",
  "file_path": "D:\\mcbuddy-mod\\scripts\\window.mjs"
}
```

```json
      }
```

```json
   }
```

```java
   @Nullable
   private static Vec3 standableSpotNear(final ServerLevel level, final Vec3 anchor, final int maxRadius) {
      BlockPos anchorPos = BlockPos.containing(anchor);
      for (int radius = 1; radius <= maxRadius; radius++) {
         for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -radius; dz <= radius; dz++) {
               if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz)) != radius) {
                  continue;
               }
               // Straight down the column: the highest thing we can stand on is usually a canopy, and
               // the advisor will not plan a step off it, so keep looking for real ground below.
               for (int y = anchorPos.getY() + MAX_RISE; y >= anchorPos.getY() - MAX_DROP; y--) {
                  BlockPos feet = new BlockPos(anchorPos.getX() + dx, y, anchorPos.getZ() + dz);
                  if (standable(level, feet)) {
                     return new Vec3(feet.getX() + 0.5, feet.getY(), feet.getZ() + 0.5);
                  }
               }
            }
         }
      }
      return null;
   }
```
with MAX_RISE=2, MAX_DROP=16 constants (replacing HEIGHT_OFFSETS).

Note: this makes the search O(rings × 19) — fine.

调试台建成，而且它这轮就用自己结掉了争论 —— 不再需要你看屏幕。

**探针给的三个硬事实**
- `world.column`：agent 那列是 `83/84 mangrove_leaves、85 起空气` —— 它一直站在红树林树冠上，这是 socket 读出来的，不是猜的。
- `blocked_by`（新）：第一次按坐标定罪 —— `block.minecraft.mangrove_leaves@40,66,-72 entities=0`。树冠确实挡路，同时**排除了"撞到人"**（entities=0）。
- `relocate`：`31.5,85,-56.5 → 30.5,85,-57.5`，不用重启就能挪 agent。

**M2 第一次健康收尾**：`task 1 -> stopped_short after 16 ticks at (44.2,67,-71.8) (refused=0 degraded=1)` —— 干净走了 4.5 格，停下纯粹因为顾问只给了部分路径。这是正确行为，不是卡死。

**我自己犯了一个错，已回退**：把"脚下不算树叶/水"这条规则同时加到了 `restHeight`，结果沼泽里每一步都 `no footing`（`refused=12 degraded=0`，一步没走）。出生要干爽、迈步只要不穿模 —— 两处判据不同是有意的，文档里写清了原因，免得下一轮又"顺手统一"。

**两件没做完的，都记进了 HANDOFF**
- `blocked_by` 只对"碰撞型"拒绝有效，`no footing` 型会误报"我们的谓词没找到东西"（task 2 就是）。这是下一轮第一件事，因为它决定这个字段能不能信。
- 暂停门：mixin 干净应用、无报错，但**行为上还没验证** —— 需要一次真的进暂停界面。
- `window.mjs` 能定位窗口、不抢焦点，但**挪不动**：客户端把自己挪回了 `525,269`。副产品是量出了真正的结论：**可见但失焦 = 稳定 20 tps**，所以敌人只有"最小化"这一个动作。

两个提交：`37be85f`（三个根因 + 物理步态）、`6a9167b`（调试台 + 出生判据）。工作区干净，客户端还开着（agent 在 `(40.5,66,-70.5)`），我为了测试在 `run/config/mcbuddy.properties` 加了一行 `keep_ticking_while_paused=true` —— 那个文件在 gitignore 里，不影响仓库。

**要你的只有一件**：下次路过那个窗口时按一次 Esc 再退出来，我就能确认暂停门真的生效（此后你不用再碰 LAN）。另外现在探针能点名障碍了，超平坦夹具的价值判断也跟着变了 —— 要不要下一轮就建，你定。

}\n'@\n`;\n\nconst run = (body) => powershell(PS + body);\n\nif (mode === 'state') {\n  const { pid, hwnd } = findWindow();\n  console.log(`pid ${pid} ` + run(`$r=New-Object W.U+R; [W.U]::GetWindowRect([IntPtr]${hwnd},[ref]$r)|Out-Null;
```java
public final class WorldFixture {
   public static JsonObject pad(final MinecraftServer server, final int radius) {
      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
      if (!BuddyConfig.devWrites) {
         out.addProperty("written", false);
         out.addProperty("reason", "dev_writes is off");
         return out;
      }
      ServerPlayer self = BuddyAgent.current();
      ...
      ServerLevel level = server.getLevel(Level.OVERWORLD);
      BlockPos centre = self.blockPosition();
      int changed = 0;
      for (int dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) for (int dz = -r; dz <= r; dz++) {
         // floor: one solid row at the agent's feet level minus 1; clear two above
         BlockPos floor = centre.offset(dx, -1, dz);
         BlockPos feet = centre.offset(dx, 0, dz);
         BlockPos head = centre.offset(dx, 1, dz);
         if (level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(SectionPos.blockToSectionCoord(floor.getX()), ...) == null) continue;  // never load
         if (level.setBlock(floor, Blocks.STONE.defaultBlockState(), Block.UPDATE_ALL, Block.UPDATE_LIMIT)) changed++;
         level.setBlock(feet, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), ...);
         level.setBlock(head, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), ...);
      }
      out.addProperty("written", true);
      out.addProperty("blocks_changed", changed);
      out.addProperty("centre", ...); out.addProperty("radius", r);
      return out;
   }
}
```

## 调试台（不用人进游戏）

桥接是 `127.0.0.1:25731` 上的换行分隔 JSON，脚本已经封好：

```bash
node scripts/probe.mjs status
node scripts/probe.mjs column [x z y0 y1]   # 一列方块 id；省略参数就用 agent 自己那一列
node scripts/probe.mjs relocate [radius]    # 把 agent 挪到最近的可站点，不用重启进程
node scripts/walktest.mjs 8 4               # 走一段，把 blocked_by 打出来
node scripts/window.mjs state|offscreen|restore
```

- `wedged` 事件自带 `blocked_by`（撞上的方块 ID + 坐标 + 实体数，或"±1 内没有落脚面 + 脚下是什么"）和 `strides_refused` / `strides_degraded` —— "为什么不动"是**从 socket 读出来的**，不是让人按 F3 截图看出来的。有截图需求就说明探针不够，补探针。（`node scripts/probe.mjs pad 6`）：在 agent 脚下铺一张 2r+1 见方的石台，只碰已加载的区块（越界的列直接跳过并计数），受 `dev_writes=true` 控制、默认关。它替代了"另开一个超平坦存档"：同样拿到可预测几何，但不用改 `build.gradle` 的 `--quickPlaySingleplayer`、不用重跑 M0/M1 的复现。注意它只清 2 格净空，更高的植被（藤蔓/树叶）会留着 —— 那些没有碰撞形状，不影响走路。

- `keep_ticking_while_paused=true`（在 `run/config/mcbuddy.properties`，默认 false）让内服在暂停界面下继续 tick，不必再"对局域网开放"。**仅开发用**，别带进产品：暂停了 companion 还在走是会让人困惑的行为。
- 实测：窗口**可见但失焦**时内服稳定 20 tps；**最小化**才是硬停（没有渲染 surface，`Cannot acquire minimized window`）。`scripts/window.mjs offscreen` 暂时挪不动 —— 客户端会把自己挪回去（rect 又变回原值），所以现阶段是"别最小化"，不是"可以丢后台"。

## 调试台（不用人进游戏）

桥接是 `127.0.0.1:25731` 上的换行分隔 JSON，脚本已经封好：

```bash
node scripts/probe.mjs status
node scripts/probe.mjs column [x z y0 y1]   # 一列方块 id；省略参数就用 agent 自己那一列
node scripts/probe.mjs relocate [radius]    # 把 agent 挪到最近的可站点，不用重启进程
node scripts/walktest.mjs 8 4               # 走一段，把 blocked_by 打出来
node scripts/window.mjs state|offscreen|restore
```

- `wedged` 事件自带 `blocked_by`（撞上的方块 ID + 坐标 + 实体数，或"±1 内没有落脚面 + 脚下是什么"）和 `strides_refused` / `strides_degraded` —— "为什么不动"是**从 socket 读出来的**，不是让人按 F3 截图看出来的。有截图需求就说明探针不够，补探针。（`node scripts/probe.mjs pad 6`）：在 agent 脚下铺一张 2r+1 见方的石台，只碰已加载的区块（越界的列直接跳过并计数），受 `dev_writes=true` 控制、默认关。它替代了"另开一个超平坦存档"：同样拿到可预测几何，但不用改 `build.gradle` 的 `--quickPlaySingleplayer`、不用重跑 M0/M1 的复现。注意它只清 2 格净空，更高的植被（藤蔓/树叶）会留着 —— 那些没有碰撞形状，不影响走路。

- `keep_ticking_while_paused=true`（在 `run/config/mcbuddy.properties`，默认 false）让内服在暂停界面下继续 tick，不必再"对局域网开放"。**仅开发用**，别带进产品：暂停了 companion 还在走是会让人困惑的行为。
- 实测：窗口**可见但失焦**时内服稳定 20 tps；**最小化**才是硬停（没有渲染 surface，`Cannot acquire minimized window`）。`scripts/window.mjs offscreen` 暂时挪不动 —— 客户端会把自己挪回去（rect 又变回原值），所以现阶段是"别最小化"，不是"可以丢后台"。

```java
   /** One alternative route per task: a blocked stride means the route is wrong, not that we cannot walk. */
   private static boolean tryAlternativeRoute(final ServerPlayer agent, final WalkTask task, final String why) {
      if (task.repathed) {
         return false;
      }
      task.repathed = true;
      task.stuckTicks = 0;
      task.refusalStreak = 0;
      Path again = PathAdvisor.to(agent.level(), agent.position(), task.target, MAX_PATH_LENGTH);
      if (again == null || again.getNodeCount() <= 1) {
         return false;   // caller finishes with the *_no_alternative status
      }
      task.path = again;
      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info("[mcbuddy] task {} {} at {}, routing around", task.id, why, agent.position());
      return true;
   }
```

## Q1 破坏：合成入站包，两条候选路都否掉

真实入口是 `ServerGamePacketListenerImpl:1388` → `gameMode.handleBlockBreakAction(pos, action, direction, maxY, sequence)`。服务端在这一个函数里替我们做完了全部裁决（`ServerPlayerGameMode`）：

| 检查 | 行 | 意义 |
|---|---|---|
| `isWithinBlockInteractionRange(pos, 1.0)` | `:168` | 够不够得到 |
| `isUnderSpawnProtection` | `:179` | 出生保护 |
| `level.mayInteract` | `:185` | 冒险/维度权限 |
| `blockActionRestricted` | `:196` | 游戏模式限制 |
| `level.destroyBlockProgress(...)` | `:232` | **人类看得见的裂纹** |

- `gameMode.destroyBlock(pos)`（`:288`）是**裁决之后**的执行端 —— 直接调它等于绕过上面整张表，那正是"作弊"的定义。
- `/setblock`、`/fill` 连"玩家"这个身份都不经过：没有手臂摆动、没有裂纹、不受 reach 约束。
- 所以破坏 = 发 `ServerboundPlayerActionPacket`（START → 按需 STOP/ABORT），sequence 用单调递增计数即可（服务端只是记账 `ackBlockChangesUpTo`）。这条链路 M0.5 已经证明能通（`selectedSlot` 0→3）。

**但有个源码逼出来的取舍**：`:191` 是 `if (this.player.getAbilities().instabuild) { destroyAndAck(...); return; }` —— **创造模式下 START 就是瞬间破坏，没有裂纹也没有挖掘时间**。而 M2 的步态恰好**依赖创造模式**：`handlePlayerPositionChange` 的判罚条件是 `movedDist > 0.0625 && !isCreative()`（`:1195-1202`），我们 0.35/tick 的步幅平方 0.1225 已经超了，换成生存就会被判 `moved wrongly` 并 setback。

→ 建议：**M3 先用创造模式打通"经原版裁决的破坏/放置"**，因为它验证的是协议与权限，不是挖掘手感；把"生存真挖掘"单列一个里程碑，它的前置是**本地物理预测**（重力+碰撞+step-up），那是比 M3 更大的一块。别在 M3 里顺手切模式 —— 会把刚验完的 M2 全推翻。

## Q2 站位求解：要做，但别自己写距离公式

谓词原版已经给了，直接复用：`Player:1998-2001`
`new AABB(pos).distanceToSqr(getEyePosition()) < (blockInteractionRange() + buffer)²`，默认 `block_interaction_range = 4.5`（`Attributes:29`），服务端调用时 `buffer = 1.0` → **眼到目标方块 AABB 距离 < 5.5**。

于是求解器就是两个已有零件的乘积：在目标周围找"可站（`BuddyAgent.standable`）且 `isWithinBlockInteractionRange(target, 1.0)` 为真"的点，交给 M2 的 `walkTo` 走过去。不需要新数学。

**两个源码给的硬前置坑**（不是猜的）：
1. `handleUseItemOn:1435` 要求 `awaitingPositionFromClient == null` —— **teleport 闩住期间放置被静默丢弃**。M2 修的那个闩锁在这里同样是命门。所以 M3 遇到"没反应"，排查顺序应该是：先看闩锁 → 再看 reach → 最后才怀疑物品。
2. `:1414` 取 `getItemInHand(hand)` 且要求 `isItemEnabled` —— 我们 agent 现在**空手**。所以 M3 第一步其实是背包/选中槽，不是 `place`。

## Q3 权限默认值：按"是否绕过玩家身份"分档，不按危险感

- **默认开**：`agent.break` / `agent.place`（合成包）。这一档**不需要额外权限层**，因为原版那张表已经在管 —— 再加一层只是把同一个判断写两遍、然后两处不一致。
- **默认关**：任何 `level.setBlock` 直写（现有 `dev_writes` 门，`WorldFixture.pad` 就是它）。理由不是"危险"，而是它绕过裁决、人类看不到过程。
- **用结构代替开关**：直写必须满足两条硬约束 —— 广播（`Block.UPDATE_ALL` 已做）+ 只碰已加载区块（`WorldFixture.loaded` 已经是这个模式）。这样"越界"在结构上不可能，而不是靠一个可以被改掉的布尔值。这也和 HANDOFF 里"不作弊由加载状态保证"是同一条原则。
- **`/setblock`/`/fill` 建议根本不做**：比 `setBlock` 更弱（多一层命令权限、少一层玩家语义），唯一优势是批量，而批量真需要时 `dev_writes` 下循环更诚实。

**先查过生态**（避免重复造）：Modrinth 上"会挖矿的 AI companion"（Core Companion、Nova、CraftyAI 等）全部是**驱动真实客户端输入**（多数靠 Baritone），没有一个把"经原版裁决的方块交互"做成协议。我们的差异点是 agent 本身就是玩家、且没有客户端可模拟 —— 所以这条链路不是重复建设。

要你拍两个板：**(a)** M3 是否按"先创造模式打通链路、生存挖掘单列里程碑"走；**(b)** 是否同意 M3 的第一个提交是**背包/物品**（否则 `place` 无从验证）。定了我就把这三条连同行号写进 HANDOFF 的 M3 段，然后开工。

public void handlePlayerAction(final ServerboundPlayerActionPacket packet) {
      PacketUtils.ensureRunningOnSameThread(packet, this, this.player.level());
      if (this.hasClientLoaded()) {
         BlockPos pos = packet.getPos();
         this.player.resetLastActionTime();
         ServerboundPlayerActionPacket.Action action = packet.getAction();
         switch (action) {
            case STAB:
               if (this.player.isSpectator()) {
                  return;
               } else {
                  ItemStack itemInHand = this.player.getItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND);
                  if (this.player.cannotAttackWithItem(itemInHand, 5)) {
                     return;
                  }

                  PiercingWeapon piercingWeapon = itemInHand.get(DataComponents.PIERCING_WEAPON);
                  if (piercingWeapon != null) {
                     piercingWeapon.attack(this.player, EquipmentSlot.MAINHAND);
                  }

                  return;
               }
            case SWAP_ITEM_WITH_OFFHAND:
               if (!this.player.isSpectator()) {
                  ItemStack swap = this.player.getItemInHand(InteractionHand.OFF_HAND);
                  this.player.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.OFF_HAND, this.player.getItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND));
                  this.player.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, swap);
                  this.player.stopUsingItem();
               }

               return;
            case DROP_ITEM:
               if (!this.player.isSpectator()) {
                  this.player.drop(false);
               }

               return;
            case DROP_ALL_ITEMS:
               if (!this.player.isSpectator()) {
                  this.player.drop(true);
               }

               return;
            case RELEASE_USE_ITEM:
               this.player.releaseUsingItem();
               return;
            case START_DESTROY_BLOCK:
            case CHANGE_DESTROY_DIRECTION:
            case ABORT_DESTROY_BLOCK:
            case STOP_DESTROY_BLOCK:
               this.player.gameMode.handleBlockBreakAction(pos, action, packet.getDirection(), this.player.level().getMaxY(), packet.getSequence());
               this.ackBlockChangesUpTo(packet.getSequence());
               return;
            default:
               throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid player action");
         }
      }
   }

#### Thinking

Excellent — this is the gold:

1. **Reach predicate is vanilla's own**: `player.isWithinBlockInteractionRange(pos, 1.0)` — with a +1.0 slack. If out of range → "too far" and (for START) nothing happens. So **we don't need our own reach math**; the server already enforces it. For 站位求解, the question is whether the agent is in range *before* sending — and the answer is: use the same predicate `player.isWithinBlockInteractionRange(pos, 1.0)` to *search* for a standable spot, then let the server enforce it. Perfect source grounding.

2. **Creative instant-break**: `if (player.getAbilities().instabuild) { destroyAndAck(...); return; }` — so our creative agent's START_DESTROY_BLOCK becomes an instant break, no crack progress! That kills the "人类看得见裂纹进度" premise for creative. So the choice of game mode matters: to get visible crack progress and real mining time, the agent must be in **survival** (or at least not instabuild).

That's a genuinely important design finding: M2's gait relied on creative to dodge "moved wrongly"/setback checks (`fail` requires `!isCreative()`). If M3 wants honest mining, we need survival — and then movement checks re-apply (0.0625 movedDist threshold → "moved wrongly" setback). Hmm! That's a real coupling: creative was load-bearing for M2.

Wait, let me re-check: in `handlePlayerPositionChange`, `fail = movedDist > 0.0625 && !sleeping && !isCreative() && !isSpectator() && !isInPostImpulseGraceTime()`. With creative off, our claimed positions that deviate > 0.25 blocks from lastGood in one tick would trip "moved wrongly" → setback. But our strides are 0.35/tick... `movedDist` is squared distance from firstGood: 0.35² = 0.1225 > 0.0625 → **would fail** in survival! So survival movement via synthesized packets needs the claimed position to match what vanilla physics would produce, including gravity accumulation. That's a significant finding: **M2's approach only works because the agent is creative.**

Also `isInPostImpulseGraceTime()` — a newer grace mechanism.

So the honest recommendation for M3:
- Break via synthesized `ServerboundPlayerActionPacket` (START/…/STOP) + sequence acks — this is the same inbound path M0/M2 proved, gives vanilla's own reach/spawn-protection/mayInteract/adventure checks, broadcasts crack progress (`level.destroyBlockProgress`), and drops items naturally.
- NOT `gameMode.destroyBlock(pos)` (that's the instant, no-progress API used by e.g. `Player.gameMode` internals; it bypasses reach and the whole interaction contract → "cheating" and invisible to the crack broadcast).
- NOT `/setblock`/`/fill` command dispatch for routine mining — reserve for bulk ops behind a separate, default-off permission.
- **But**: the game mode choice is now the crux. Creative = instant break (no crack, `instabuild` short-circuit at :193) and it's also what makes our M2 gait legal. Survival = real mining with visible progress, but then movement packets face the `moved wrongly` check (0.0625 threshold) and gravity, so the gait must become a real local physics prediction.
  Recommendation: keep creative for M3 development (so M2 stays valid), and treat "survival mode" as its own milestone with the physics-prediction work it needs — because that's a much bigger change than M3.
  Alternatively: `player.getAbilities().instabuild` false but creative game mode? `gameModeForPlayer` = CREATIVE implies instabuild. There's also `GameType.CREATIVE` vs abilities separately settable — we could set `GameType.SURVIVAL` + `abilities.mayfly`? Hmm, instabuild is tied to creative.
  Actually there's a middle option: keep CREATIVE (movement legal, instant break) but *also* implement a "visible mining" path later. Or: use `GameType.ADVENTURE`? no.

3. **Placement**: `useItemOn` at :369 — need to read its checks (reach + `canInteractWithBlock`?). Let me read a bit. Also `handlePlayerInteract`/`ServerboundUseItemOnPacket` handler in the listener.

4. **Sequence acks**: `ackBlockChangesUpTo(sequence)` — and there's `ClientboundBlockChangedAckPacket`. Our fake client receives outbound packets but can't read them (unconfigured pipeline) — so we don't need to ack anything outbound; the *inbound* sequence is what we send. But note: `ackBlockChangesUpTo` sets `ackgedBlockChanges`? It's server-side tracking of the client's acks. If we send sequence numbers, the server just records them. Should be harmless. So the server's check is `AABB(pos).distanceToSqr(eye) < (4.5 + 1.0)² = 5.5²` — i.e. **5.5 blocks from the eye to the target block's AABB** for both break and place. I now have a complete, source-grounded design. Let me write the recommendation. Structure:

**Q1: 破坏走哪条路？** → 合成入站包（`ServerboundPlayerActionPacket` START/…/STOP + sequence），不要 `gameMode.destroyBlock`，不要命令派发。证据：
- `ServerGamePacketListenerImpl:1388` → `gameMode.handleBlockBreakAction(...)` + `ackBlockChangesUpTo(sequence)`。
- `ServerPlayerGameMode:168` 服务端自己判 `isWithinBlockInteractionRange(pos, 1.0)`；`:176` 出生保护；`:182` `level.mayInteract`；`:193` **creative → `destroyAndAck` 瞬间破坏**；`:202` `blockActionRestricted`（冒险模式限制）；`:230` `level.destroyBlockProgress(...)` = 人类看得见的裂纹。
- `destroyBlock(pos)`（`:288`）是"已经判定过了"的执行端，绕过上面全部检查 → 那是作弊路径，也正是我们要避免的。
- 命令派发（`/setblock`）连"玩家"这个身份都不经过，人类看不到手臂摆动/裂纹，也不受 reach/spawn protection 约束。

**但有一个必须先决定的代价**：creative 下 START 直接 insta-mine（`:193`），**没有裂纹、没有挖掘时间**，"人类看得见"这条就只剩手臂摆动。要真挖掘就得 survival —— 而 M2 的步态恰恰**依赖 creative**：`handlePlayerPositionChange` 的 `fail` 条件是 `movedDist > 0.0625 && !isCreative()`（`:1201-1207`），我们 0.35/tick 的步幅平方是 0.1225 > 0.0625，换成 survival 就会被判 "moved wrongly" 并 setback。
→ 建议：M3 先用 creative 打通"经原版裁决的破坏/放置"这条链路（因为它验证的是**协议与权限**，不是挖掘手感），把"survival 真挖掘"单列成一个里程碑，它的前置是**本地物理预测**（重力+碰撞+step-up），那是比 M3 更大的一块。别在 M3 里顺手切模式，会把 M2 刚验完的东西全推翻。

**Q2: 站位求解要不要做？** → 要，但**不要自己写距离公式**，直接复用服务端的谓词：
- `Player:1998-2001`：`isWithinBlockInteractionRange(pos, buffer)` = `new AABB(pos).distanceToSqr(getEyePosition()) < (blockInteractionRange() + buffer)²`。
- 默认 `block_interaction_range = 4.5`（`Attributes:29`），服务端调用时 buffer=1.0 → **眼到目标方块 AABB 的距离 < 5.5**。
- 所以站位求解 = 在目标方块周围找"可站 且 `isWithinBlockInteractionRange(target, 1.0)` 为真"的点。可站判据我们已经有了（`BuddyAgent.standable`/`restHeight`），reach 判据用原版那个，两者一拼就是求解器；M2 的 `walkTo` 直接当执行器。
- 还必须先解决的一个坑（源码给的，不是猜的）：`handleUseItemOn:1435` 要求 **`awaitingPositionFromClient == null`** —— 也就是说**teleport 闩住期间放置会被静默丢弃**。这正是 M2 修掉的那个闩锁。所以 M3 任何"没反应"的排查顺序应该是：先看闩锁，再看 reach，最后才怀疑物品。
- 另一个硬前置：放置要手里真有方块。`handleUseItemOn:1414` 取 `getItemInHand(hand)` 且要求 `isItemEnabled`；我们 agent 现在是空手创造模式。所以 M3 的第一步其实是**背包/选中槽**（`selected_slot` 那条链路 M0.5 已经验过能改）。

**Q3: 权限默认值** → 按"是否绕过玩家身份"分档，而不是按"危险程度"感觉分档：
- 默认开：`agent.break` / `agent.place`（合成入站包，服务端裁决一切：reach、出生保护、mayInteract、冒险限制、裂纹广播）。这一档**不需要额外权限层**，因为原版已经在管。
- 默认关：任何 `level.setBlock` 直写（我们已经有 `dev_writes` 这条门，`WorldFixture.pad` 就是它）。理由：它绕过上面所有检查，人类看不到过程，而且能写到未加载区块 —— 那就不再是"一名玩家能做的事"。
- 建议加一个**可见性约束**而不是权限位：任何直写都必须广播（`Block.UPDATE_ALL` 已经做到），并且**只允许已加载区块**（`WorldFixture.loaded` 已有这个模式）。这样"越界"在结构上不可能，而不是靠开关。
- `/setblock`、`/fill` 命令派发：我建议**根本不做**。它比 `setBlock` 更弱（多一层命令权限、少一层玩家语义），唯一优势是批量，而批量真需要时用 `dev_writes` 下的循环更诚实。

三个问题都能从源码定死。核心结论：**M3 不该选"哪条 API 更方便"，而是"哪条路径经过了原版对一名玩家的裁决"。**

## Q1 破坏：合成入站包，两条候选路都否掉

真实入口是 `ServerGamePacketListenerImpl:1388` → `gameMode.handleBlockBreakAction(pos, action, direction, maxY, sequence)`。服务端在这一个函数里替我们做完了全部裁决（`ServerPlayerGameMode`）：

| 检查 | 行 | 意义 |
|---|---|---|
| `isWithinBlockInteractionRange(pos, 1.0)` | `:168` | 够不够得到 |
| `isUnderSpawnProtection` | `:179` | 出生保护 |
| `level.mayInteract` | `:185` | 冒险/维度权限 |
| `blockActionRestricted` | `:196` | 游戏模式限制 |
| `level.destroyBlockProgress(...)` | `:232` | **人类看得见的裂纹** |

- `gameMode.destroyBlock(pos)`（`:288`）是**裁决之后**的执行端 —— 直接调它等于绕过上面整张表，那正是"作弊"的定义。
- `/setblock`、`/fill` 连"玩家"这个身份都不经过：没有手臂摆动、没有裂纹、不受 reach 约束。
- 所以破坏 = 发 `ServerboundPlayerActionPacket`（START → 按需 STOP/ABORT），sequence 用单调递增计数即可（服务端只是记账 `ackBlockChangesUpTo`）。这条链路 M0.5 已经证明能通（`selectedSlot` 0→3）。

**但有个源码逼出来的取舍**：`:191` 是 `if (this.player.getAbilities().instabuild) { destroyAndAck(...); return; }` —— **创造模式下 START 就是瞬间破坏，没有裂纹也没有挖掘时间**。而 M2 的步态恰好**依赖创造模式**：`handlePlayerPositionChange` 的判罚条件是 `movedDist > 0.0625 && !isCreative()`（`:1195-1202`），我们 0.35/tick 的步幅平方 0.1225 已经超了，换成生存就会被判 `moved wrongly` 并 setback。

→ 建议：**M3 先用创造模式打通"经原版裁决的破坏/放置"**，因为它验证的是协议与权限，不是挖掘手感；把"生存真挖掘"单列一个里程碑，它的前置是**本地物理预测**（重力+碰撞+step-up），那是比 M3 更大的一块。别在 M3 里顺手切模式 —— 会把刚验完的 M2 全推翻。

## Q2 站位求解：要做，但别自己写距离公式

谓词原版已经给了，直接复用：`Player:1998-2001`
`new AABB(pos).distanceToSqr(getEyePosition()) < (blockInteractionRange() + buffer)²`，默认 `block_interaction_range = 4.5`（`Attributes:29`），服务端调用时 `buffer = 1.0` → **眼到目标方块 AABB 距离 < 5.5**。

于是求解器就是两个已有零件的乘积：在目标周围找"可站（`BuddyAgent.standable`）且 `isWithinBlockInteractionRange(target, 1.0)` 为真"的点，交给 M2 的 `walkTo` 走过去。不需要新数学。

**两个源码给的硬前置坑**（不是猜的）：
1. `handleUseItemOn:1435` 要求 `awaitingPositionFromClient == null` —— **teleport 闩住期间放置被静默丢弃**。M2 修的那个闩锁在这里同样是命门。所以 M3 遇到"没反应"，排查顺序应该是：先看闩锁 → 再看 reach → 最后才怀疑物品。
2. `:1414` 取 `getItemInHand(hand)` 且要求 `isItemEnabled` —— 我们 agent 现在**空手**。所以 M3 第一步其实是背包/选中槽，不是 `place`。

## Q3 权限默认值：按"是否绕过玩家身份"分档，不按危险感

- **默认开**：`agent.break` / `agent.place`（合成包）。这一档**不需要额外权限层**，因为原版那张表已经在管 —— 再加一层只是把同一个判断写两遍、然后两处不一致。
- **默认关**：任何 `level.setBlock` 直写（现有 `dev_writes` 门，`WorldFixture.pad` 就是它）。理由不是"危险"，而是它绕过裁决、人类看不到过程。
- **用结构代替开关**：直写必须满足两条硬约束 —— 广播（`Block.UPDATE_ALL` 已做）+ 只碰已加载区块（`WorldFixture.loaded` 已经是这个模式）。这样"越界"在结构上不可能，而不是靠一个可以被改掉的布尔值。这也和 HANDOFF 里"不作弊由加载状态保证"是同一条原则。
- **`/setblock`/`/fill` 建议根本不做**：比 `setBlock` 更弱（多一层命令权限、少一层玩家语义），唯一优势是批量，而批量真需要时 `dev_writes` 下循环更诚实。

**先查过生态**（避免重复造）：Modrinth 上"会挖矿的 AI companion"（Core Companion、Nova、CraftyAI 等）全部是**驱动真实客户端输入**（多数靠 Baritone），没有一个把"经原版裁决的方块交互"做成协议。我们的差异点是 agent 本身就是玩家、且没有客户端可模拟 —— 所以这条链路不是重复建设。

要你拍两个板：**(a)** M3 是否按"先创造模式打通链路、生存挖掘单列里程碑"走；**(b)** 是否同意 M3 的第一个提交是**背包/物品**（否则 `place` 无从验证）。定了我就把这三条连同行号写进 HANDOFF 的 M3 段，然后开工。

public void handlePlayerAction(final ServerboundPlayerActionPacket packet) {
      PacketUtils.ensureRunningOnSameThread(packet, this, this.player.level());
      if (this.hasClientLoaded()) {
         BlockPos pos = packet.getPos();
         this.player.resetLastActionTime();
         ServerboundPlayerActionPacket.Action action = packet.getAction();
         switch (action) {
            case STAB:
               if (this.player.isSpectator()) {
                  return;
               } else {
                  ItemStack itemInHand = this.player.getItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND);
                  if (this.player.cannotAttackWithItem(itemInHand, 5)) {
                     return;
                  }

                  PiercingWeapon piercingWeapon = itemInHand.get(DataComponents.PIERCING_WEAPON);
                  if (piercingWeapon != null) {
                     piercingWeapon.attack(this.player, EquipmentSlot.MAINHAND);
                  }

                  return;
               }
            case SWAP_ITEM_WITH_OFFHAND:
               if (!this.player.isSpectator()) {
                  ItemStack swap = this.player.getItemInHand(InteractionHand.OFF_HAND);
                  this.player.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.OFF_HAND, this.player.getItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND));
                  this.player.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, swap);
                  this.player.stopUsingItem();
               }

               return;
            case DROP_ITEM:
               if (!this.player.isSpectator()) {
                  this.player.drop(false);
               }

               return;
            case DROP_ALL_ITEMS:
               if (!this.player.isSpectator()) {
                  this.player.drop(true);
               }

               return;
            case RELEASE_USE_ITEM:
               this.player.releaseUsingItem();
               return;
            case START_DESTROY_BLOCK:
            case CHANGE_DESTROY_DIRECTION:
            case ABORT_DESTROY_BLOCK:
            case STOP_DESTROY_BLOCK:
               this.player.gameMode.handleBlockBreakAction(pos, action, packet.getDirection(), this.player.level().getMaxY(), packet.getSequence());
               this.ackBlockChangesUpTo(packet.getSequence());
               return;
            default:
               throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid player action");
         }
      }
   }

**M3 设计已按源码定稿**（写进 HANDOFF，带行号）：破坏走合成 `ServerboundPlayerActionPacket`，因为 `handleBlockBreakAction` 一个人管完 reach(`:168`)、出生保护(`:179`)、`mayInteract`(`:185`)、冒险限制(`:196`)、裂纹广播(`:232`)；`destroyBlock`(`:288`) 是裁决**之后**的执行端，直接调就是绕过裁决；`/setblock`、`/fill` 建议根本不做。站位求解复用 `Player:1998` + 默认 4.5 距离，不写新公式。

Let me write `breakAt`.

```java
   /**
    * A click and release on the block itself: START then STOP, the way a real client sends a break.
    * The server runs its own gauntlet (ServerPlayerGameMode:168 reach, :179 spawn protection, :185
    * mayInteract, :196 adventure restriction) and in creative insta-mines at :191, so no crack
    * progress appears until the survival milestone.
    */
   public static JsonObject breakAt(final BlockPos pos) {
      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
      ServerPlayer self = agent;
      if (self == null) { out.addProperty("broken", false); out.addProperty("reason", "no agent spawned"); return out; }
      ServerLevel level = self.level();
      out.addProperty("target", blockId(level.getBlockState(pos)));
      out.addProperty("within_reach", self.isWithinBlockInteractionRange(pos, 1.0));
      out.addProperty("teleport_latched", Boolean.valueOf(teleportLatched(self)));
      sendInbound(new ServerboundPlayerActionPacket(ServerboundPlayerActionPacket.Action.START_DESTROY_BLOCK, pos, Direction.UP, nextSequence()));
      sendInbound(new ServerboundPlayerActionPacket(ServerboundPlayerActionPacket.Action.STOP_DESTROY_BLOCK, pos, Direction.UP, nextSequence()));
      String after = blockId(level.getBlockState(pos));
      out.addProperty("after", after);
      out.addProperty("broken", "air".equals(after));
      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info("[mcbuddy] break {} -> {} (latched={})", pos, after, Boolean.valueOf(teleportLatched(self)));
      return out;
   }
```
Note: `Direction.UP` as the clicked face — the server stores destroyDirection; for START it doesn't matter much in creative. Fine.

站位求解做完了，顺带纠正一件我差点记错的事。

**求解器**：`agent.stand_for` 不自己写公式，直接用 `Player:1998-2001` 那条判据（目标 AABB 到**候选点眼睛**的距离 < `blockInteractionRange() + 1.0`）叠加 spawn 用的同一个 `standable`。实测：

**我差点把"没验证"记成"验证过了"**：你按 Esc 那会儿我测到 tick 在涨，但日志里 `Saving and pausing game` 出现 **0 次** —— 客户端根本没进暂停界面，我测到的只是"可见失焦 = 20 tps"这个已知事实。所以我把它改成**我能自己证明**的形式：`status` 现在带 `client_paused` / `server_paused` 和两个开关。**麻烦你再按一次 Esc 并停在菜单里约 10 秒**，我读一次就能定论（之后这件事永远不需要你插手）。

2. 被拒后我们只会 repath，而**顾问不知道我们为什么被拒**，从同一点重算出的第一步还是同一个方向。

**关于 batch —— 可以做，而且这正是设计记录里那块"无模型的 goal executor"**（草案已进 HANDOFF）：

- `agent.run {steps:[...]}` 立刻返回 `{accepted, plan_id}`，进度走事件（`step_done` / `plan_done` / `plan_failed`），**不轮询** —— 一次调用换游戏内 N tick，符合你的 token 约束。
- v1 词汇表只用已实测的能力：`move`、`move_to_block`（= `stand_for`+`move`，省一次往返）、`pick`/`dig`/`place`（**自动先走到够得着的位置**，而不是甩回 `within_reach:false` 让模型自己想办法）、`say`（就是"汇报给用户"那一步，聊天入站路径 M0.5 已通）、`wait`。

但有个前提我得说清楚：**先修上面那两个缺口，否则 batch 只是把现在的 wedge 打包上报**，计划跑不长远。两个修法都很小（出生要求 ≥2 个开放邻居；被拒时先换个方向再计入拒绝）。

Hmm — `standable` checks the cell itself + head + ground + one open horizontal neighbour. If it found an open neighbour, at least ONE direction should be steppable... unless the open neighbour is more than 0.35 away in the *diagonal* sense... no, the stride aims along the route, not necessarily toward the open neighbour.

Right: the route (from the advisor) picks a direction; if that direction is blocked, we refuse and wedge — even though another direction is open. That's the real limitation: **we only ever follow the advisor's route; we never try a different one until the wedge→repath**. And the repath from the same position gives the same first step (the advisor doesn't know about our refusal).

So the missing piece is exactly what the user is asking for at a higher level, but the *local* fix is: on refusal, try the other directions (or aim at the target directly rather than at the node). Interesting: `closing` mode aims at the target directly. A cheap, principled improvement: when a stride is refused, retry the candidate aimed at the **target** instead of the node (a different direction), before giving up.

But hold on — the deeper issue: the spawn placed the agent at y=71 in a spot where it can't step in the route direction. The spawn predicate guarantees *an* exit exists, not that the exit is toward the target.

What does this mean for the batch design? It's the key argument FOR the batch: a step like `move_to(x,y,z)` needs a *retry-with-different-approach* policy, and the batch runner is where "step failed → try another approach → report" lives. Also it argues the solver should choose the *approach direction* (walk to a cell whose first step is clear), not just any reachable cell.

Design of the batch runner (`agent.run`):
- Shape: `{"method":"agent.run","params":{"steps":[{...},{...}]}}` → returns `{"accepted":true,"task_id":7}` immediately; progress via events (`step_done` / `plan_done` / `plan_failed`) — matches "事件推送而非轮询" + token economy.
- Steps (vocabulary, all model-free, each one existing capability):
  - `{"do":"move","x":..,"y":..,"z":..}` or `{"do":"move_to_block","x":..,"y":..,"z":..}` (auto stand_for + walk)
  - `{"do":"dig","x":..,"y":..,"z":..}` (stand_for → move if needed → break)
  - `{"do":"place","x":..,"y":..,"z":..}` (stand_for → move → place; needs hand)
  - `{"do":"pick","x":..,"y":..,"z":..}`
  - `{"do":"say","text":"..."}` → chat to the human (the "汇报给用户" step)
  - maybe `{"do":"wait","ticks":n}`
- Semantics: strictly sequential; a failed step **stops the plan** by default and the event carries the step index + the reason string the individual tool already produces (`blocked_by`, `within_reach:false`, `no solid neighbour...`). Optional `on_fail: "continue"`.
- Ownership: one plan at a time (like WalkTask's `current`), cancelled by `agent.remove`/world unload; a `cancel` method with the plan id.
- Why server-side and not in the model loop: this is the "无模型的 goal executor" the design record already calls for — tick-level retry doesn't belong in a token-billed loop. One MCP call, N game ticks, one event back.
- Timeout: per-step deadline (e.g. move = 3× est_ticks) so a wedged step can't hang the plan.

**求解器**：`agent.stand_for` 不自己写公式，直接用 `Player:1998-2001` 那条判据（目标 AABB 到**候选点眼睛**的距离 < `blockInteractionRange() + 1.0`）叠加 spawn 用的同一个 `standable`。实测：

```
stand_for 39 66 -75 8  -> {"range_blocks":6,"reachable":true,"stand":"38.5,68.0,-74.5","from_target_blocks":1}
```

`range_blocks: 6` 就是源码里的 4.5 + 1.0 —— 求解器不可能和服务端算成两套，因为它用的是同一条计算。

**我差点把"没验证"记成"验证过了"**：你按 Esc 那会儿我测到 tick 在涨，但日志里 `Saving and pausing game` 出现 **0 次** —— 客户端根本没进暂停界面，我测到的只是"可见失焦 = 20 tps"这个已知事实。所以我把它改成**我能自己证明**的形式：`status` 现在带 `client_paused` / `server_paused` 和两个开关。**麻烦你再按一次 Esc 并停在菜单里约 10 秒**，我读一次就能定论（之后这件事永远不需要你插手）。

**走到那个点的任务失败了，而失败更有价值**：agent 出生在 `(21.5,71,-63.5)`，`wedged after 25 ticks (refused=24 degraded=24)`，`stride 2..4` 全 `via blocked`。根因是两条规则的缺口：

1. `standable` 只保证"**存在**一个出口"，不保证出口在**路线要的方向**上。
2. 被拒后我们只会 repath，而**顾问不知道我们为什么被拒**，从同一点重算出的第一步还是同一个方向。

**关于 batch —— 可以做，而且这正是设计记录里那块"无模型的 goal executor"**（草案已进 HANDOFF）：

- `agent.run {steps:[...]}` 立刻返回 `{accepted, plan_id}`，进度走事件（`step_done` / `plan_done` / `plan_failed`），**不轮询** —— 一次调用换游戏内 N tick，符合你的 token 约束。
- v1 词汇表只用已实测的能力：`move`、`move_to_block`（= `stand_for`+`move`，省一次往返）、`pick`/`dig`/`place`（**自动先走到够得着的位置**，而不是甩回 `within_reach:false` 让模型自己想办法）、`say`（就是"汇报给用户"那一步，聊天入站路径 M0.5 已通）、`wait`。
- 严格顺序；某步失败默认终止计划，事件带步序号 + 该步**自己产出的原因字符串**（`blocked_by`、`no solid neighbour to click from`、`empty hand - agent.pick first`），不另造错误码。每步带 deadline（move 类用 `est_ticks × 3`，和 M2 验收同一个系数），别让一个 wedge 挂住整条计划。

但有个前提我得说清楚：**先修上面那两个缺口，否则 batch 只是把现在的 wedge 打包上报**，计划跑不长远。两个修法都很小（出生要求 ≥2 个开放邻居；被拒时先换个方向再计入拒绝）。

**提交**：`04f67e0`（求解器 + 暂停探针）。要我按"两个缺口 → batch 执行器"这个顺序做下去吗？词汇表里有你想改的地方也现在说，`say` 那步是唯一碰到聊天路径的，我按现有 mixin 走。

2. **`break` 在创造模式下是瞬间消失**（`ServerPlayerGameMode:191`），没有裂纹进度 —— 与预测一致。想要人类看得见挖掘过程，必须等"生存 + 本地物理预测"那个里程碑，不要在创造模式上假装它发生了。
3. **放置永远需要一个可点的相邻面**。`placeAt` 因此是"找目标的一个非空气邻居、点它的朝向目标那一面"，命中点取两格中心的中点（距被点方块中心 0.5，稳过 `:1422` 的 `<1.0000001` 判定）。目标悬空时返回 `no solid neighbour to click from` —— 这也是玩家遇到的真实约束，不是我们的限制。
4. 协议里所有方块/物品名统一走注册表 ID（`blockId`/`id`），不再混用翻译键 —— `vine`、`mangrove_leaves`、`air`，而不是 `block.minecraft.vine`。

### 先查过生态（避免重复造）


`BuddyAgent.standFor` 不自己写公式：它用 `Player:1998-2001` 的同一条判据（目标 AABB 到**候选点眼睛**的距离 < `blockInteractionRange() + 1.0`），叠加 spawn 用的同一条 `standable`，从目标向外一圈圈找。实测：

```
agent.stand_for 39 66 -75 8  -> {"range_blocks":6,"reachable":true,"stand":"38.5,68.0,-74.5","from_target_blocks":1}
```

`range_blocks: 6` 正是源码给的 4.5 + 1.0 —— 求解器和服务端不会各算一套。

**但走到那个点的任务失败了**，而且失败得有价值：agent 出生在 `(21.5,71,-63.5)`，`walk task 1 -> wedged after 25 ticks (refused=24 degraded=24)`，`stride 2..4` 全是 `via blocked` —— 它被树冠围住了。根因是两条规则的缺口：

1. `standable` 只保证"**存在**一个能迈出去的邻居"，不保证那个邻居在**路线要的方向**上；顾问给的第一步方向是堵的。
2. 被拒之后我们只会 repath，而**顾问不知道我们为什么被拒**，从同一点重算出的第一步还是同一个方向 → 于是 `wedged`。

### **You**

mcp做完了吗？

### **Assistant**

没做。M4（MCP stdio 外壳）到现在**一行都没有** —— 我核对了代码：仓库里没有任何 JSON-RPC / `tools/list` / stdio 服务，`build.gradle` 也没有 MCP 依赖。设计里它是有意排在最后的。

**但 M4 要包的那层"实体"已经齐了** —— 14 个方法在 `127.0.0.1:25731` 上，换行分隔 JSON：

```
读：ping  status  world.digest  world.column  events.poll  task.status
动：agent.walk_to  agent.stand_for  agent.relocate  agent.teleport*
做：agent.pick  agent.place  agent.break  world.pad*        （* = dev_writes 门）
```

协议层无状态这条已经天然满足：状态只有一份在游戏里，跨请求靠 `task_id` / `event cursor` 回传。所以缺的**只是壳**：`tools/list` + `tools/call` 映射到 socket，一个文件。

#### Thinking

The user asks: "可以。用typescript编排吗？" = "OK. Should the orchestration be in TypeScript?"

This is a design question about where the batch/plan runner lives: Java (in the mod, server-side) vs TypeScript (an external orchestrator in scripts/ or the MCP shell).

This is an important architectural fork. Let me think carefully and give a real recommendation with the tradeoff — and it should be grounded in the ratified design decisions in HANDOFF/DESIGN:

Design record says:
- 进程内 mod + 外挂 agent loop（模型在外）
- "BYOK 唯一的省 token 理由是把模型放进 tick 级回路，而那层应该是**无模型的 goal executor**"
- MCP stdio 外壳推迟到最后，现在 scripts/*.mjs 已经能从会话里直接驱动游戏

So the question: is the plan runner the "无模型的 goal executor" (Java, in-process) or is it orchestration sugar in the external TS layer?

Arguments for TypeScript orchestration:
- Iteration speed: no rebuild/restart per change (we've paid this cost ~8 times today). Huge.
- The MCP shell will be Node/TS anyway (M4), so the vocabulary/schema lives in one place.
- Multi-step plans that involve *model* decisions (e.g. "mine until you have 8 blocks") belong outside the game process.
- Testing: you can run a plan against a live game and change the plan without touching the mod.

Arguments for Java (in-process) execution:
- **Atomicity/timing**: a plan step like "dig" requires waiting for ticks (the walk takes N ticks). If TS orchestrates, it must poll `task.status`/events over the socket — that's fine (it already does) but adds latency and a polling loop per step.
- **The agent keeps running when the TS process dies**: if the plan lives in TS and the orchestrator crashes/closes, the agent stops mid-plan. If it's in-process, the plan survives the client's owner. But honestly for a dev rig that's minor... except the design says "游戏侧有状态，协议层无状态；重启不影响 agent" — that's about the *game* being the source of truth. A plan is arguably game state (the agent is "doing something").
- **Tick-level primitives**: retry-on-refusal, deadline in ticks — these are tick-driven, and doing them in TS means polling at 20Hz. Bad for token economy AND for precision.
- **One source of truth for state**: if the plan is in TS, then "what is the agent doing right now" isn't answerable from the game — `status` would lie (it'd say idle while the TS runner is between steps).

Key insight: **there are two different layers being conflated.**
1. **The executor** (in-game, tick-driven, stateless-model): runs a *submitted* step list, emits events, owns "what is the agent doing". This must be Java — because it needs tick timing and because the game must be able to answer "what are you doing" truthfully.
2. **The composer** (outside, model-driven or scripted): decides *what* the plan should be, from a chat/CLI/MCP session. This is where TypeScript shines — and it's also where the model already is.

So my recommendation: **both, split at that seam**. Java gets a thin `PlanRunner` (~150 lines) that accepts a step list and executes/emits; TS gets the authoring/inspection side (`scripts/plan.mjs`, and later the MCP shell just forwards `agent.run`). Crucially the step vocabulary is *small and stable* because the primitives already exist in Java — so the churn the design wanted to avoid is confined to TS.

Also: TS orchestration alone (no Java runner) is a real option — `scripts/plan.mjs` loops over steps, calls the socket, polls events. Cost: a polling loop per step, and the game can't answer "what is the agent doing". Benefit: zero mod changes, instant iteration. For a *dev rig* that's actually pretty attractive... and it's the honest cheaper first step.

Given the user's token economy + the fact they're asking (they suspect TS is better), I'd recommend: **start with TS orchestration for the plan runner, and only move it into Java when a plan must survive the orchestrator or needs tick-level precision.** Concretely:
- v1 in TS: `scripts/plan.mjs` runs a JSON plan (the user's example: move → dig nearest {block} → report), calling existing methods and awaiting events. No mod change → no rebuild → we can iterate the vocabulary in minutes.
- What we must add in Java for that to work well: a way to **await** a step cheaply. We already have `events.poll {cursor}` — TS can poll with a cursor and no new code. And `task.status.running`. So TS v1 needs **zero** mod changes. 
- One genuine gap for "挖掘范围内的{方块}": the model needs to *find* a block of type X in reach → that's a **query** the game must answer (`world.find {block, radius}`), which IS a Java addition (a read-only scan over loaded chunks). That's the one thing TS can't do for us.
- Later, promote to Java only if: plans must outlive the orchestrator, or a step needs sub-tick timing.

That's a crisp, well-reasoned answer with a concrete recommendation and the one real prerequisite (`world.find`).

Also mention the "dig nearest X" example needs `world.find` — and note the honesty constraint: find only over loaded chunks (same rule as digest/column).

Let me answer concisely, with the recommendation and the tradeoff, and ask to proceed. I should NOT implement yet since this is a design fork question they asked.

Keep it fairly short — they asked a yes/no-ish question.

`at` 就是 PTC 的意义：**"先走到够得着的位置"不再需要模型花三个回合去发现 `within_reach:false`。**

- 你的原始三步（移动 → 挖范围内方块 → 汇报）：`ptc.mjs --demo` → **1054 ms、一个进程、一条结果**：`{"reported":"挖掉了 9,73,-54","after":"air","candidates":169,"walked_ticks":4}`。

#### Thinking

"programmatic-tool-calling" — PTC = Programmatic Tool Calling. That's a known concept (Anthropic's "programmatic tool calling" / code-execution-with-tools pattern: instead of the model emitting one tool call per turn and getting a result back into context, the model writes a **program** that calls tools in a loop, and only the program's final output returns to context).

So the user is saying: design the orchestration as **programmatic tool calling** — i.e. the plan is *code* that calls tools, executed in a sandbox/runner, with token-efficient results. That reframes my previous answer:

- The "plan" isn't a bespoke JSON step vocabulary we invent (`{steps:[{do:"move"}]}`) — it's a **small program** in a real language (TypeScript/JS) that the model writes, and a host executes it against the tool API. That's exactly what PTC means, and it's what I was leaning toward with "TS orchestration" — but the design consequence is sharper:
  1. **Don't invent a plan DSL.** Give the program the *same* tool surface the socket has (`status`, `world.find`, `agent.walk_to`, `await walk_done(...)`, `agent.dig`), as an async API. The language already has loops/conditionals/errors — that's the whole point of PTC: the model writes `for`, `if`, `await` instead of burning turns on a step list.
  2. **Sandbox/host**: a runner that executes the submitted program with a timeout, no filesystem/network except the loopback socket, and returns a compact result. That's the "PTC host".
  3. **Token economy**: only the program's *return value* comes back to the model, not every intermediate event. That's the real win vs. my earlier `agent.run {steps}` design.
  4. **Primitives must be awaitable**: `await agent.dig(pos)` must resolve when the dig is done/failed, with the reason. Today the game's async part is the walk (tick-driven), so the host needs `wait for walk event with cursor` — that's already possible over the socket.
  5. **State truth**: the game still answers "what is the agent doing" because the *agent* is doing one primitive at a time via existing methods. The plan lives outside; that's acceptable under PTC because the program is ephemeral and the model can re-read state. (My earlier objection #1 is weakened by PTC: the program is the caller, like a human typing commands, and it's normal for the game not to know about a caller's script.)
  6. Still need `world.find` — a program can't do "dig the nearest moss" without a query.

So the design becomes: **a PTC host for mcbuddy**:
- `scripts/ptc.mjs` (or a small module) exposing an async `mcbuddy` API over the socket, with awaitable actions.
- A `program.run` entry point: model submits JS source → host executes with a timeout → returns JSON result. Where does the host run? Two options: (a) in the CLI session (Node, TS) — simplest, matches "scripts drive the game"; (b) inside the MCP shell later as a `tools/call` named `run_program`.
- Safety: no fs/net beyond the socket, CPU/time budget, and the *game-side* permission model unchanged (dev_writes etc.).

The PTC host design:
```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Programmatic tool calling host: give it a program, it runs against the live game and prints only
// what the program returns. The model writes control flow; the socket stays the only capability.
// Usage: node scripts/ptc.mjs <program-file>   (or --src '<js>')
```

- `mcbuddy` API object with async methods over the socket: `status()`, `column()`, `find()`, `walkTo(x,y,z)`, `standFor(x,y,z)`, `pick`, `place`, `dig`, `pad`, `tp`, `say`? — `say` doesn't exist yet (chat output). For the demo I'll skip `say` and return the report as the program's result (that IS the PTC point: the program's return value is what comes back).
- Awaitable walk: `walkTo` submits then polls `task.status` + `events.poll` until the walk event for that task_id arrives or timeout; resolves `{status, ticks, blocked_by, x,y,z}`.
- Sandbox: `node:vm` with a timeout, no require/process/fs exposed. That's the honest PTC host: the program gets only `mcbuddy` + `console`-free.

Let me write it with `vm.runInNewContext(src, {mcbuddy}, {timeout: 60000})`. Note: vm timeout doesn't work with async ops (the timeout applies to synchronous execution). For an async program, I need my own deadline. Approach: wrap the program as an async function body and race with a timer:
```js
const program = new vm.Script(`(async () => { ${src} })()`);  // vm.Script + createContext
```
Simpler and honest: use `vm.createContext({mcbuddy})` + `vm.runInContext` returning a promise, then `await Promise.race([promise, deadline])`. Since the host is our own CLI running dev scripts the model/user writes, the sandbox is a courtesy boundary, not a security boundary — I should say that in a comment (honest about limits).

A loop that waits\n// for a walk, checks the reason, and tries the next candidate costs nothing here; expressed as tool\n// calls it would cost one round trip each. That is a capability boundary, not a\n// security one: this is a dev rig executing code you wrote. Polling the cursor\n// rather than the position means a step cannot look idle just because the tick rate dipped.\nasync function walkTo(cell) {\n  const started = await ask('events.poll', { cursor: 0 });\n  const accepted = await ask('agent.walk_to', cell);\n  if (!accepted.accepted) return { status: 'rejected', reason: accepted.reason };\n  const deadline = Date.now() + Math.max(30000, accepted.est_ticks_lower_bound * 3 * 50);\n  for (;;) {\n    await sleep(700);\n    const events = await ask('events.poll', { cursor: started.latest ?? 0 });\n    const done = (events.events ?? []).find(e => e.type === 'walk' && e.data.task_id === accepted.task_id);\n    if (done) return done.data;\n    if (Date.now() > deadline) return { status: 'timeout', task_id: accepted.task_id };\n  }\n}\n\nconst mcbuddy = {\n  status: () => ask('status'),\n  find: args => ask('world.find', args),\n  column: args => ask('world.column', args),\n  standFor: cell => ask('agent.stand_for', cell),\n  pick: cell => ask('agent.pick', cell),\n  dig: cell => ask('agent.break', cell),\n  place: cell => ask('agent.place', cell),\n  walkTo,\n  // Walk to the nearest cell from which `cell` can actually be reached, then run the action.\n  // This is the seam where a plan would otherwise burn turns discovering within_reach:false.\n  async at(cell, action) {\n    const stand = await this.standFor(cell);\n    if (!stand.reachable) return { ok: false, reason: `no standing position in range: ${stand.reason ?? ''}` };\n    const walked = await walkTo(parseCell(stand.stand));\n    if (walked.status !== 'reached' && walked.status !== 'reached_near') {\n      return { ok: false, reason: `could not get into range: ${walked.status}`, walked, stand: parseCell(stand.stand) };\n    }\n    const result = await this[action](cell);\n    return { ok: true, walked, stand: parseCell(stand.stand), result };\n  },\n};\n\nconst DEMO = `\n// The user's three steps: move, dig the nearest block of a kind, report.\nasync (mcbuddy) => {\n  const before = await mcbuddy.status();\n  const found = await mcbuddy.find({ block: 'stone', radius: 10 });\n  if (!found.matches?.length) {\n    return { reported: '附近没有可挖的石头', loaded_columns: found.columns_loaded, absent_columns: found.columns_absent };\n  }\n  const target = found.matches[0];\n  const done = await mcbuddy.at(target, 'dig');\n  return {\n    reported: done.ok ? \\`挖掉了 \\${target.x},\\${target.y},\\${target.z}\\` : \\`没能挖到：\\${done.reason}\\`,\n    from: before.agent.pos,\n    candidates: found.total_matches,\n    target,\n    walked_ticks: done.walked?.ticks,\n    after: done.result?.after,\n  };\n}\n`;\n\nconst source = process.argv[2] === '--demo' || !process.argv[2] ? DEMO : readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');\nconst context = vm.createContext({ mcbuddy });\nconst startedAt = Date.now();\n\ntry {\n  const factory = await vm.runInContext(`(${source.trim().startsWith('async') ? source : source})`, context, { timeout: TIMEOUT_MS });\n  const result = await Promise.race([\n    factory(mcbuddy),\n    new Promise((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('plan deadline exceeded')), TIMEOUT_MS)),\n  ]);\n  console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, ms: Date.now() - startedAt, result }, null, 1));\n} catch (err) {\n  console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, ms: Date.now() - startedAt, error: String(err?.message ?? err) }));\n  process.exitCode = 1;\n}\n",

Program: dig up to 3 stones within radius 12, stop when a dig fails twice, report what happened.

```js
async (mcbuddy) => {
  const log = [];
  let dug = 0;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 6 && dug < 3; attempt++) {
    const found = await mcbuddy.find({ block: 'stone', radius: 12 });
    const target = found.matches?.[attempt % Math.max(1, found.matches.length)];
    if (!target) break;
    const done = await mcbuddy.at(target, 'dig');
    log.push({ target, ok: done.ok, reason: done.reason ?? done.result?.after });
    if (done.ok) dug++;
  }
  return { dug, log };
}
```
Hmm, `matches[attempt % len]` is a weird selector. Simpler: iterate matches directly:
```js
async (mcbuddy) => {
  const found = await mcbuddy.find({ block: 'stone', radius: 12 });
  const log = [];
  for (const target of (found.matches ?? [])) {
    if (log.filter(l => l.ok).length >= 3) break;
    const done = await mcbuddy.at(target, 'dig');
    log.push({ at: `${target.x},${target.y},${target.z}`, ok: done.ok, note: done.ok ? done.result.after : done.reason });
  }
  return { dug: log.filter(l => l.ok).length, tried: log.length, log };
}
```
That's a genuine loop with early exit — 3 digs out of up to 10 candidates, and it shows partial failures. Each `at` involves a walk (~seconds). 10 iterations could take a while... The deadline is 180s. Let me cap by slicing: `(found.matches ?? []).slice(0,5)`.

Let me run it.

```java
   /**
    * The agent speaks. A fake player cannot produce a chat signature, so the packet path is closed to
    * us: handleChat validates the last-seen checksum first and disconnects on failure (:1706-1715),
    * and the signature half needs a key pair we do not have. This calls the same endpoint the server

    * the agent - what is skipped is the transport crypto, not the visibility or the chat type.
    */
   public static JsonObject say(final MinecraftServer server, final String text) {
      JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
      ServerPlayer self = agent;
      if (self == null) { out.addProperty("said", false); out.addProperty("reason", "no agent spawned"); return out; }
      String trimmed = text.length() > 256 ? text.substring(0, 256) : text;
      server.getPlayerList().broadcastChatMessage(
            PlayerChatMessage.unsigned(self.getUUID(), trimmed), self, ChatType.bind(ChatType.CHAT, self));
      out.addProperty("said", true);
      out.addProperty("text", trimmed);
      Mcbuddy.LOGGER.info("[mcbuddy] agent says: {}", trimmed);
      return out;
   }
```

package dev.tsy3m.mcbuddy.mixin;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import dev.tsy3m.mcbuddy.BuddyCommands;
import dev.tsy3m.mcbuddy.bridge.EventQueue;
import net.fabricmc.api.EnvType;
import net.fabricmc.api.Environment;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ServerboundChatPacket;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.server.network.ServerGamePacketListenerImpl;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Mixin;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.Shadow;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.At;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.Inject;
import org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.callback.CallbackInfo;

@Environment(EnvType.CLIENT)
@Mixin(ServerGamePacketListenerImpl.class)
public class ServerGamePacketListenerImplChatMixin {
   @Shadow
   public ServerPlayer player;

   @Inject(
      method = "handleChat(Lnet/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ServerboundChatPacket;)V",
      at = @At("HEAD"),
      cancellable = true
   )
   private void mcbuddy$console(final ServerboundChatPacket packet, final CallbackInfo ci) {
      String message = packet.message();
      if (!message.startsWith("!buddy")) {
         return;
      }
      ci.cancel();
      String reply = BuddyCommands.run(this.player.level().getServer(), message);
      this.player.level()
         .getServer()
         .getPlayerList()
         .broadcastSystemMessage(Component.literal("[mcbuddy] " + reply), false);
   }

   @Inject(
      method = "handleChat(Lnet/minecraft/network/protocol/game/ServerboundChatPacket;)V",
      at = @At("TAIL")
   )
   private void mcbuddy$captureChat(final ServerboundChatPacket packet, final CallbackInfo ci) {
      JsonObject event = new JsonObject();
      event.addProperty("from", this.player.nameAndId().name());
      event.addProperty("text", packet.message());
      EventQueue.add("chat", event);
   }
}

```json
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n// Listen for a human speaking in game. Exits on the first chat line after our cursor.\n//\n// This is the push half of \"a companion in the background\": the game already records chat as an\n// event, so waiting for a message costs a poll on a cursor, not a model turn.\n// Usage: node scripts/listen.mjs [--timeout 300] [--all]\nimport net from 'node:net';\n\nconst PORT = Number(process.env.MCBUDDY_PORT || 25731);\nconst timeoutSec = Number(process.argv.includes('--timeout') ? process.argv[process.argv.indexOf('--timeout') + 1] : 300);\nconst wantAll = process.argv.includes('--all');\nlet id = 0;\n\nfunction ask(method, params) {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const socket = net.connect(PORT, '127.0.0.1');\n    let buffer = '';\n    const timer = setTimeout(() => { socket.destroy(); reject(new Error(`${method}: timeout`)); }, 8000);\n    socket.on('error', err => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(err); });\n    socket.on('connect', () => socket.write(JSON.stringify({ id: ++id, method, params }) + '\\n'));\n    socket.on('data', chunk => {\n      buffer += chunk.toString('utf8');\n      const line = buffer.split('\\n')[0];\n      if (!line.trim()) return;\n      clearTimeout(timer);\n      socket.end();\n      const parsed = JSON.parse(line);\n      parsed.ok ? resolve(parsed.result) : reject(new Error(`${method}: ${parsed.error}`));\n    });\n  });\n}\n\nconst sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));\n\nlet cursor;\ntry {\n  cursor = (await ask('status')).event_cursor;\n} catch (err) {\n  console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: `cannot reach the bridge: ${err.message}` }));\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n\nconst deadline = Date.now() + timeoutSec * 1000;\nconst heard = [];\nfor (;;) {\n  await sleep(1200);\n  let polled;\n  try {\n    polled = await ask('events.poll', { cursor });\n  } catch {\n    continue;   // the game may be mid-save; a dropped poll is not a missed message\n  }\n  cursor = polled.latest ?? cursor;\n  for (const event of polled.events ?? []) {\n    if (event.type !== 'chat') continue;\n    heard.push(event.data);\n    console.log(`<${event.data.from}> ${event.data.text}`);\n    if (!wantAll) {\n      console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, heard: event.data }));\n      process.exit(0);\n    }\n  }\n  if (Date.now() > deadline) {\n    console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, reason: 'timeout', heard }));\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n",

}
```

你屏幕现在应该能看到：`<buddy> 你好，我收到了。我在 附近`。

**这一轮证明了双向回路，而且一行 Java 都没改、没重启** —— 聊天在 M0.5 就已经进事件队列了，缺的只是外面有人听。`<Player725> 你好` → 我收到 → `agent.say` → 服务端和渲染端各一条 `[Not Secure] <buddy> …`。

**顺手抓到一个我自己的 bug**：`ptc.mjs` 把 `events.poll` 的游标字段读成 `latest`（不存在），于是每次轮询都从 seq 0 重来。因为 task_id 唯一所以结果碰巧是对的 —— 正是那种"看起来能用、实际在空转"的东西，等真做事件驱动壳时才会炸出来。已修，已提交（`39f2489`）。

**一句别过度解读的话**：我回的"我在 附近"是**我临时编的文本，不是从状态算出来的**。真正该长成"我在 `<39,74,-55>`，脚下是石台"这种由 `status` 驱动的话 —— 那是下一步的内容，不是今天已经有的能力。

**离"后台跟着玩"还差三件**，按依赖排：

done;\n    (done.placed ? built : failed).push({ ...cell, why: item.why, reason: done.placed ? undefined : done.reason ?? done.target_after });\n  }\n\n  const summary = `房子盖好了：${built.filter(b => b.why === 'wall').length} 墙 / ${built.filter(b => b.why === 'roof').length} 顶，材料 ${material.block}`;\n  await mcbuddy.say(summary);\n  return {\n    ok: failed.length === 0,\n    human: { x: hx, y: human.y, z: hz },\n    arrived,\n    site: { cx, cz, base, size: `${R * 2 + 1}x${R * 2 + 1}x${HEIGHT}` },\n    material,\n    cleared: cleared.length,\n    built: { wall: built.filter(b => b.why === 'wall').length, roof: built.filter(b => b.why === 'roof').length, lintel: built.filter(b => b.why === 'lintel').length },\n    failed,\n    reported: summary,\n  };\n}\n",

```json
}
```
